d: We are far more than a worldwide leader in hospitality. We welcome you as you are and offer opportunities to find a role and brand that truly match your personality and aspirations. During your journey with us, you will have the opportunity to explore limitless possibilities, shape your own story, and help us imagine the future of hospitality together.

Spanning 275,000 square metres, the very best of indulgence, relaxation, and adventure come together in an All-Inclusive experience like no other- all-encompassing, uncompromising, and unmatched.

Under the general direction of the Director of Marketing, the Graphic Designer is responsible for developing creative and visually engaging designs that support the hotel's marketing, branding, and communication strategies. The role involves creating high-quality visual content for digital and print platforms while ensuring consistency with Rixos Hotels' brand identity, corporate standards, and marketing objectives.
Graphic design and visual content development.
Digital and print marketing materials production.
Brand consistency and corporate identity compliance.
Marketing Department operational standards, policies, and procedures adherence.
Develop creative concepts and visual designs that support the hotel's marketing and communication objectives.
Create and produce marketing materials for digital and print platforms, including brochures, flyers, posters, menus, banners, advertisements, social media content, and promotional materials.
Ensure all designs are consistent with Rixos Hotels' brand identity, guidelines, and visual standards.
Work closely with the Director of Marketing and Marketing Executive to develop and execute marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
Design visual content for hotel events, seasonal campaigns, special occasions, and promotional initiatives.
Prepare and adapt artwork for various digital platforms, ensuring appropriate formats, dimensions, and quality.
Coordinate with internal departments to understand their design requirements and deliver creative solutions within agreed timelines.
Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
Review and amend designs based on feedback from management and relevant departments.
Maintain organized digital files, artwork, templates, and design assets for future use.
Support photography and videography projects, including creative direction and visual content requirements when needed.
Stay updated on current graphic design trends, creative technologies, and industry best practices.
Ensure all final artwork is accurate, professionally presented, and ready for digital publication or printing.
Perform all duties and responsibilities in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with established hotel policies.
Attend departmental and communication meetings as requested by the Director of Marketing.
Ensure Rixos Hotels' Sales & Marketing policies and Standard Operating Procedures are followed at all times.
Promote efficiency, professionalism, courtesy, and strong communication skills.
Maintain positive working relationships and effective coordination with all hotel departments.
Demonstrate a positive attitude, professional appearance, and commitment to the hotel's image and reputation.
Maintain confidentiality and comply with all company and hotel rules and regulations.
Demonstrate flexibility in adapting to changing priorities and working hours according to business needs.
Participate in training and development programs as recommended by management.
Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Director of Marketing or senior management.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
Minimum 2-3 years of relevant experience within a design agency, creative studio, or corporate marketing environment.
Previous experience in hospitality or luxury brands is an advantage.
Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, versatility, and design capabilities.
